title: Bridge of $\Psi$'s: Quantum Circuit Optimization with Schr\"odinger Bridges
abstract: arXiv:2609.25947v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum circuit optimization replaces a circuit with an equivalent one of fewer gates and lower depth, reducing execution cost and error rate. We ask whether a generative model can learn this transformation directly from examples, rather than selecting from a fixed rewrite library or rigid algebraic routines. We present Bridge of $\Psi$'s (BOPS), a generative model based on Schr\"odinger bridges, using a custom denoiser architecture, that learns a transformation from a source circuit into an equivalent optimized circuit. We train it on data constructed to be hard for existing optimizers, by applying rewrite rules backwards so that each input has a known lower-cost target. On held-out 8 qubits $\times$ 64 depth Clifford+$T$ circuits, BOPS reduces gate count by $2.46\times$ and depth by $2.45\times$ in geometric mean, outperforming all nine baseline optimizers. translated_title: Ψ之桥：基于薛定谔桥的量子电路优化
translated_abstract: 量子电路优化是指将一个电路替换为门数更少、深度更低的等效电路，从而降低执行成本和错误率。我们探究生成模型能否直接从示例中学习这种变换，而不是从固定的重写规则库或僵化的代数例程中进行选择。我们提出了Bridge of Ψ's（BOPS），一个基于薛定谔桥的生成模型，采用定制的去噪器架构，学习从源电路到等效优化电路的变换。我们在对现有优化器而言较为困难的数据上对其进行训练，方法是通过反向应用重写规则，使每个输入都有一个已知的更低成本目标电路。在留出的8量子比特×64深度的Clifford+T电路上，BOPS在几何平均上将门数减少2.46倍、深度减少2.45倍，优于全部九个基线优化器。这构成了首个连接量子电路与……的生成模型。
tldr: BOPS是一种基于薛定谔桥的生成模型，能直接从示例学习将量子电路变换为等效的优化电路，在8量子比特×64深度的Clifford+T电路上将门数和深度分别以几何平均减少2.46倍和2.45倍，超越了全部九个基线优化器。
en_tdlr: BOPS is a Schrödinger bridge-based generative model that learns directly from examples to transform quantum circuits into equivalent optimized ones, reducing gate count by 2.46× and depth by 2.45× in geometric mean on 8-qubit × 64-depth Clifford+T circuits, outperforming all nine baseline optimizers.
